name: task-queue
description: Codex logs its own work as tasks in your Task Queue account: it opens a task with its estimate when new work starts and marks it done with the end time when finished, so admins can track AI coding activity.

interface.shortDescription: Log Codex work as Task Queue tasks.
interface.longDescription: Codex opens a Task Queue task with its own estimate when new work starts, keeps follow-up prompts on that task, and marks it done with the end time when the work is finished.
